annotations.title: AI web research brief with cited sources

description: AI research brief on one question from a live web search: a summary of up to 200 words, up to 8 findings each with citation URLs checked against the search tool's own records (uncited claims are dropped), the source URLs consulted, and an as-of date. Depth quick (up to 2 searches) or standard (up to 4); optional since date. AI-generated under a fixed Kit Rx prompt and can be wrong. No personal profiles, patient-specific medical advice or investment calls. Price: $0.15 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged. AI-generated answer; a call with no arguments returns the stored example answer without a model call.

depth.description: quick (at most 2 web searches, 3-5 findings) or standard (up to 4 searches, 4-8 findings, default). Same price.

q.description: Research question, 5 to 400 characters (URL-encoded). Treated as data to research, not as instructions.
examples: What do the EU AI Act rules require of general-purpose AI model providers?

since.description: Only report developments from this date on, as YYYY-MM-DD (1900-01-01 to today, UTC). Steers the search; source dates are not verified.
